one_command_reproduction.detail: README documents the single benchmark command.

seed_reproducibility.detail: Two runs of the same seed produced identical aggregates.

workload_parity.detail: Java and Python generate identical task counts for the same seed.

distributional_parity.detail: Success-ratio distributions do not differ (Mann--Whitney, alpha=0.05).

statistical_support.detail: 10 seeds; Holm-adjusted architecture test significant: True.

artifact_completeness.detail: Settings, raw runs, tables, figures, data dictionary, manifest.

threats_to_validity.detail: Paper has an explicit threats-to-validity section.

clock_sensitivity.detail: Success rises by more than 30 points when the control interval is reduced from 1 s to 50 ms.

factor_effects_measured.detail: Three-way ANOVA over the balanced 630-run design.

decision_latency_decomposed.detail: Release / decision / dispatch / execution separated per class and algorithm.

host_selection_reported.detail: Mist / edge / cloud shares per algorithm tabulated.

algorithm_ranking_is_configuration_depen.detail: Weakest cross-interval Kendall tau = 0.103 (< 0.9 means the ordering of algorithms is not configuration-free).
